description: This file defines an interface named LoanDropdownReadPlatformService, which declares multiple methods related to retrieving various dropdown options for loan product configurations in a financial application. It serves as a contract for implementing classes that will provide data for loan-related dropdown menus, such as amortization types, interest types, repayment frequencies, and reschedule strategies.

classes.name: LoanDropdownReadPlatformService
classes.description: An interface declaring methods to retrieve various loan dropdown options.

methods.name: retrieveLoanAmortizationTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns a list of options for loan amortization types.

methods.name: retrieveLoanInterestTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns a list of options for loan interest types.

methods.name: retrieveLoanInterestRateCalculatedInPeriodOptions
methods.description: Returns options for interest rate calculation periods.

methods.name: retrieveLoanTermFrequencyTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns options for loan term frequency types.

methods.name: retrieveRepaymentFrequencyTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns options for repayment frequency types.

methods.name: retrieveRepaymentFrequencyOptionsForNthDayOfMonth
methods.description: Returns repayment frequency options applicable for the Nth day of the month.

methods.name: retrieveRepaymentFrequencyOptionsForDaysOfWeek
methods.description: Returns repayment frequency options based on days of the week.

methods.name: retrieveInterestRateFrequencyTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns options for interest rate frequency types.

methods.name: retrieveTransactionProcessingStrategies
methods.description: Returns a collection of transaction processing strategy data objects.

methods.name: retrieveLoanCycleValueConditionTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns options for loan cycle value condition types.

methods.name: retrieveInterestRecalculationCompoundingTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns options for interest recalculation compounding types.

methods.name: retrieveInterestRecalculationNthDayTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns options for interest recalculation Nth day types.

methods.name: retrieveInterestRecalculationDayOfWeekTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns options for interest recalculation day of the week types.

methods.name: retrieveInterestRecalculationFrequencyTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns options for interest recalculation frequency types.

methods.name: retrievePreCloseInterestCalculationStrategyOptions
methods.description: Returns options for pre-close interest calculation strategies.

methods.name: retrieveRepaymentStartDateTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns options for repayment start date types.
